definitions.gloss: to gain on; to close the gap; to mount a comeback
definitions.explanation: To narrow the distance or difference between oneself and a leader or competitor. Used in races, competitions, polls, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: They rallied all at once in the second half.

examples.japanese: 2⟦{位|い}→〜位：00443_i⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ランナー→ランナー：09483_rannaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{先頭|せんとう}→先頭：04374_sentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{上|あ}げて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The second-place runner is closing in on the leader.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{終盤|しゅうばん}→終盤：13793_shuuban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{猛烈|もうれつ}→猛烈：13490_mouretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{上|あ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: In the final stretch of the election, the opposition candidate mounted a fierce rally.

notes:
USAGE:
{追|お}い{上|あ}げる is commonly used in sports, elections, and business to describe closing a gap with the leader. The noun form {追|お}い{上|あ}げ is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{猛烈|もうれつ}→猛烈：13490_mouretsu⟧な{追|お}い{上|あ}げ (fierce rally/comeback)
- ⟦{終盤|しゅうばん}→終盤：13793_shuuban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追|お}い{上|あ}げ (late rally)
- {追|お}い{上|あ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show a rally)
- ⟦じわじわ→じわじわ：06682_jiwajiwa⟧{追|お}い{上|あ}げる (to gradually close the gap)

FORMS:
Compound of ⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧ (to chase) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise). The ～⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ pattern indicates upward movement or intensification.
